question: 关于离子温度梯度(ITG)驱动的微不稳定性,下列说法正确的是(多选):

options.A: 它由离子温度梯度与曲率漂移(或 bad curvature)耦合驱动,是托卡马克离子通道湍流的主要候选
options.B: 其线性增长率与电子温度梯度成正比
options.C: 其典型极向波长量级为离子拉莫尔半径ρ_i(即 k_⊥ρ_i~0.1-1)
options.D: 它在平坦密度剖面下必然被完全抑制

metadata.source: 回旋动理学微不稳定性公开教科书/综述(ITG/TEM)
metadata.notes: B 错:ITG 由离子温度梯度驱动;D 错:密度梯度起稳定/解稳作用但不必然完全抑制

evidence.cross_source: gyrokinetics 综述 ITG 章节

question_en: Regarding the ion temperature gradient (ITG)-driven microinstability, which of the following statements are correct? (Select all that apply)

options_en.A: It is driven by the coupling between the ion temperature gradient and curvature drift (or bad curvature), and is the main candidate for ion channel turbulence in tokamaks.
options_en.B: Its linear growth rate is proportional to the electron temperature gradient.
options_en.C: Its typical poloidal wavelength is on the order of the ion Larmor radius ρ_i (i.e., k_⊥ρ_i ~ 0.1-1)
options_en.D: It is necessarily completely suppressed under a flat density profile.

question: 捕获电子模(TEM)与 ITG 的一个关键区分特征是传播方向。正确的是?

options.A: TEM(电子方向/电子逆磁方向)与 ITG(离子方向)沿相反方向传播,是线性与非线性诊断的重要区分
options.B: TEM 与 ITG 传播方向相同,无法区分
options.C: TEM 沿离子逆磁方向传播

metadata.source: 回旋动理学微不稳定性公开综述
metadata.notes: 传播方向区分是实验与模拟常用判据

question_en: A key distinguishing feature between Trapped Electron Mode (TEM) and ITG is the propagation direction. Which of the following is correct?

options_en.A: TEM (electron direction / electron diamagnetic direction) and ITG (ion direction) propagate in opposite directions, which is an important distinction between linear and nonlinear diagnostics.
options_en.B: TEM and ITG have the same propagation direction and cannot be distinguished.
options_en.C: TEM propagates in the ion diamagnetic direction
options_en.D: TEM does not propagate and is a standing wave.

question: 撕裂模(tearing mode)的物理图像中,下列哪些正确(多选)?

options.A: 它改变磁场拓扑,在有理面(q=m/n)处形成磁岛
options.B: 它由电阻率(或电子惯性)使理想 MHD 的冻结约束失效而允许磁重联
options.C: 经典撕裂模增长率随电阻率按 η^(3/5) 标度(Furth-Killeen-Rosenbluth)
options.D: 它只发生在真空中,与等离子体无关

metadata.notes: Δ' 判据与 η^(3/5) 标度是标准内容

question_en: In the physical picture of the tearing mode, which of the following are correct? (Select all that apply)

options_en.A: It changes the magnetic field topology and forms magnetic islands at the rational surface (q=m/n).
options_en.B: It causes the breakdown of the frozen-in constraint of ideal MHD via resistivity (or electron inertia), thereby allowing magnetic reconnection.
options_en.C: The growth rate of the classical tearing mode scales with resistivity as η^(3/5) (Furth-Killeen-Rosenbluth)
options_en.D: It only occurs in vacuum and has nothing to do with plasma

question: 新古典撕裂模(NTM)与经典撕裂模的本质区别是?

options.A: NTM 由磁岛导致的自举电流(bootstrap current)亏损驱动/放大,具有阈值特性(需要有限大小的种子岛)
options.B: NTM 不需要种子扰动,是线性不稳
options.D: NTM 只在外部线圈驱动时出现

metadata.source: NTM 公开综述(Rutherford 方程;bootstrap-driven islands)
metadata.notes: 阈值/种子岛是 NTM 与经典撕裂的关键区别

question_en: What is the essential difference between the neoclassical tearing mode (NTM) and the classical tearing mode?

options_en.A: NTM 由磁岛导致的自举电流(bootstrap current)亏损驱动/放大,具有阈值特性(需要有限大小的种子岛)
options_en.B: NTM does not require a seed perturbation and is linearly unstable.
options_en.C: NTM is independent of bootstrap current
options_en.D: NTM occurs only when driven by external coils

question: 鱼骨模(fishbone)不稳定性的驱动机制是?

options.A: 高能(捕获)粒子与内扭曲模(m/n=1/1)的共振耦合,周期性地把快粒子能量倾泻出来
options.B: 电子温度梯度直接驱动
options.C: 外加 RMP 线圈驱动
options.D: 等离子体旋转剪切驱动

metadata.source: 鱼骨模公开综述(快粒子-MHD 耦合)
metadata.notes: 鱼骨周期脉冲是快粒子不稳定性标志

question_en: What is the driving mechanism of the fishbone instability?

options_en.A: The resonant coupling between energetic (trapped) particles and the internal kink mode (m/n=1/1) periodically dumps the energy of fast particles.
options_en.B: 电子温度梯度直接驱动
options_en.C: 外加 RMP 线圈驱动

question: 消防水带(firehose)与镜像(mirror)不稳定性发生的物理条件是什么?

options.A: 压力各向异性:p_∥ 与 p_⊥ 之差超过磁场张力/压力阈值;firehose 在 p_∥>p_⊥ 过大时,mirror 在 p_⊥>p_∥ 过大时
options.B: 两者都只在等温等离子体中发生
options.D: 两者只发生在 z 箍缩中

metadata.source: 压力各向异性不稳定性(公开教科书,Kruskal-Oberman/CGL)
metadata.notes: CGL 双绝热框架下的判据

question_en: What are the physical conditions for the occurrence of firehose instability and mirror instability?

options_en.A: 压力各向异性:p_∥ 与 p_⊥ 之差超过磁场张力/压力阈值;firehose 在 p_∥>p_⊥ 过大时,mirror 在 p_⊥>p_∥ 过大时
options_en.B: Both of them occur only in isothermal plasmas.
options_en.D: Both occur only in the Z-pinch.

question: 电子温度梯度(ETG)模与 ITG 相比,典型区别是?

options.A: ETG 在电子拉莫尔半径尺度(k_⊥ρ_e~1)驱动电子通道热输运,且与 ITG 共存于不同尺度
options.B: ETG 与 ITG 尺度完全相同
options.D: ETG 不能驱动湍流输运

metadata.source: ETG 公开综述(电子温度梯度模, ρ_e 尺度)
metadata.notes: ρ_e 尺度 vs ρ_i 尺度是关键区别

question_en: What is the typical difference between the electron temperature gradient (ETG) mode and the ITG mode?

options_en.A: ETG drives thermal transport in the electron channel at the scale of the electron Larmor radius (k_⊥ρ_e~1) and coexists with ITG at different scales.
options_en.B: The scales of ETG and ITG are exactly the same

question: 关于声波(离子声波)朗道阻尼,正确的说法是?

options.A: 当 T_e≫T_i 时离子声波弱阻尼可以传播;T_e≈T_i 时强离子朗道阻尼使其迅速衰减
options.B: 离子声波在所有温度比下都无阻尼
options.D: T_i 越高,离子声波越容易传播

metadata.source: 离子声波朗道阻尼(公开教科书)

evidence.cross_source: 等离子体波教科书章节

question_en: Regarding Landau damping of sound waves (ion acoustic waves), which statement is correct?

options_en.A: When T_e ≫ T_i, weakly damped ion acoustic waves can propagate; when T_e ≈ T_i, strong ion Landau damping causes them to decay rapidly.
options_en.B: Ion acoustic waves are undamped at all temperature ratios.
options_en.D: The higher the T_i, the easier it is for ion acoustic waves to propagate.

question: 磁化等离子体中哨声(whistler)波的特征是?

options.A: 右旋偏振、频率低于电子回旋频率、色散关系 ω∝k²(长波段近似),群速度随频率增加
options.B: 左旋偏振且只能在 ω>Ω_ce 传播

metadata.source: 哨声波公开教科书(空间等离子体)

evidence.cross_source: 等离子体波教科书章节

question_en: What are the characteristics of whistler waves in magnetized plasma?

options_en.A: 右旋偏振、频率低于电子回旋频率、色散关系 ω∝k²(长波段近似),群速度随频率增加
options_en.B: 左旋偏振且只能在 ω>Ω_ce 传播
options_en.D: The frequency is independent of k.

question: 关于漂移波不稳定性的'普适'(universal)驱动机制,下列正确的是(多选):

options.A: 密度梯度本身即可在耗散(碰撞/ Landau 共振)存在时使漂移波不稳
options.B: 漂移波在无耗散的理想极限下必然稳定
options.C: 电子对电场的绝热响应是漂移波准电中性的基础
options.D: 漂移波必须有磁场曲率才存在

metadata.source: 漂移波公开教科书(密度梯度驱动与耗散解稳机制)
metadata.notes: D 错:平板几何也有漂移波

question_en: Regarding the "universal" driving mechanism of drift wave instability, which of the following are correct? (Multiple selection):

options_en.A: The density gradient itself can destabilize drift waves in the presence of dissipation (collision / Landau resonance).
options_en.B: Drift waves are necessarily stable in the ideal dissipationless limit.
options_en.C: The adiabatic response of electrons to the electric field is the basis for the quasineutrality of drift waves.
options_en.D: Drift waves require magnetic field curvature to exist.

question: 关于电阻性壁模(RWM)在先进托卡马克中的意义,正确的是?

options.A: 当理想 MHD 外扭曲模在有导电壁时本已稳定,但无壁理想不稳定时,RWM 以壁电阻时间尺度增长,需要主动反馈控制
options.B: RWM 与壁材料电阻无关
options.C: RWM 只影响低 β 运行
options.D: RWM 是理想 MHD 模,与耗散无关

metadata.source: RWM 公开综述(先进托卡马克 β 极限)
metadata.notes: RWM 决定有无壁时可达 β 的差距

question_en: Regarding the significance of the resistive wall mode (RWM) in advanced tokamaks, which of the following is correct?

options_en.A: When the ideal MHD external kink mode is already stable in the presence of a conducting wall but ideally unstable in the absence of the wall, the RWM grows on the wall resistivity time scale and requires active feedback control.
options_en.B: RWM is independent of the resistance of the wall material
options_en.D: RWM is an ideal MHD mode and is independent of dissipation.

question: 关于误差场(error field)与锁模,正确的有(多选):

options.A: 线圈安装误差导致的非轴对称磁场可在有理面共振,穿透等离子体并锁住旋转
options.B: 锁模常触发撕裂模并可能引发破裂
options.C: 误差场只影响仿星器,不影响托卡马克
options.D: 误差场校正线圈(EFC)可补偿误差场

metadata.notes: C 错:托卡马克同样关心

question_en: Regarding error fields and mode locking, which of the following statements are correct? (Multiple choices):

options_en.A: The non-axisymmetric magnetic field caused by coil installation errors can resonate at the rational surface, penetrate the plasma, and lock its rotation.
options_en.B: Mode locking often triggers tearing modes and may cause disruptions.
options_en.C: Error fields only affect stellarators, not tokamaks.
options_en.D: Error Field Correction Coils (EFC) can compensate for error fields.

question: 关于动理学气球模(KBM)与离子尺度湍流的关系,正确的说法是?

options.A: 当归一化压力梯度 α 接近理想气球模阈值时,KBM 可在离子尺度(k_⊥ρ_i~1)被激发,并与 ITG 谱系连接
options.B: KBM 与理想气球模无关
options.C: KBM 只在电子尺度发生
options.D: KBM 不受 α 影响

metadata.source: KBM 公开研究综述(α 阈值与尺度)
metadata.notes: KBM 是 ITG-气球模谱系的重要环节

question_en: Which of the following statements regarding the relationship between the kinetic ballooning mode (KBM) and ion-scale turbulence is correct?

options_en.A: When the normalized pressure gradient α approaches the ideal ballooning mode threshold, KBM can be excited at the ion scale (k_⊥ρ_i~1) and connect to the ITG spectrum.
options_en.B: KBM is independent of the ideal ballooning mode
options_en.C: KBM only occurs on the electron scale
options_en.D: KBM is not affected by α
